New billing info (effective immediately):
- Legal name: Greenbridge SignalWorks, Inc.
- Remit address: 1201 Harbor Ave, Suite 200, Boston, MA 02110
- US EIN: 12-3456789
- VAT (EU) registration: GB-SW-998877

I've attached the acquisition notice for your records (greenbridge-acq-notice.pdf). AP also requested a contact at Redwood for collections coordination and a copy of the reissued invoice with the VAT line displayed separately.

Can you confirm next steps and whether you need any additional tax docs?

Thanks,

Thanks for the update, Sophie — congrats on the close.

We can reissue invoice #4852 to Greenbridge SignalWorks, Inc. and update the remit address, but finance will need the following to process the change and avoid payment delays:
- Official W-9 (or W-8 if non-US entity) and VAT registration docs

I'll loop in Rishi from Finance to coordinate the reissue and confirm whether we should apply any credits/adjustments related to the transition. Once we have the docs we aim to send a corrected invoice within 2 business days.

Who from AP should we expect payment communications from (email + name)?
